jei.autarkia.ascension.worn: Worn by the player in this slot
jei.autarkia.info.advanced_circuit: Electrolyzer: 2 basic circuits + 1 vantite ingot, 20 s. For T4 machines and outposts.
jei.autarkia.info.aegis_blade: 30 damage, 2 attacks/s. 500 FE per hit: armor protects only a quarter as much against the hit. Use: Aegis sweep, 20 damage to every hostile mob within 6 blocks, 50,000 FE, 5 s cooldown. Unbreakable, 100,000,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.aegis_boots: 5 armor, 5 toughness, 0.25 knockback resistance. Unbreakable, 10,000,000 FE. Keeps every exo rig, frontier suit and lattice carapace boot function. Within 64 blocks of a powered domain node (tether) the functions cost no FE and the piece charges at 50,000 FE/t; without it they use the piece's FE. Full set: the tether pays 50,000 FE per damage point. Suit key: on/off.
jei.autarkia.info.aegis_chest: 10 armor, 5 toughness, 0.25 knockback resistance. Unbreakable, 10,000,000 FE. Keeps every exo rig, frontier suit and lattice carapace chest function. Within 64 blocks of a powered domain node (tether) the functions cost no FE and the piece charges at 50,000 FE/t; without it they use the piece's FE. Full set: the tether pays 50,000 FE per damage point. Suit key: on/off.
jei.autarkia.info.aegis_helmet: 5 armor, 5 toughness, 0.25 knockback resistance. Unbreakable, 10,000,000 FE. Keeps every exo rig, frontier suit and lattice carapace helmet function. Within 64 blocks of a powered domain node (tether) the functions cost no FE and the piece charges at 50,000 FE/t; without it they use the piece's FE. Full set: the tether pays 50,000 FE per damage point. Suit key: on/off.
jei.autarkia.info.aegis_legs: 8 armor, 5 toughness, 0.25 knockback resistance. Unbreakable, 10,000,000 FE. Keeps every exo rig, frontier suit and lattice carapace leg function. Within 64 blocks of a powered domain node (tether) the functions cost no FE and the piece charges at 50,000 FE/t; without it they use the piece's FE. Full set: the tether pays 50,000 FE per damage point. Suit key: on/off.
jei.autarkia.info.aegis_multitool: Pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, shears and sword-efficient, netherite level, speed 2,000: instant up to hardness 66. 14 damage, 1.2 attacks/s. 50 FE per block. Mode key: 1x1, 3x3 or 5x5 (full speed). Enchant key: none, Silk Touch or Fortune III. Unbreakable, 100,000,000 FE, charges from the tether at 50,000 FE/t.
jei.autarkia.info.aegis_plate: 32,768 MU, made only in the matter compiler (51.2 s, 16,777,216 FE). For all T6 machines and the Aegis gear.
jei.autarkia.info.ai_core: Fabricator, 20 s: 4 advanced circuits, 1 lattice crystal, 2 nanite paste, 1 diamond. For Replicator Walkers.
jei.autarkia.info.arc_rifle: 5,000 FE per shot, 32 blocks. 10 arc damage, then 3 hops within 6 blocks at x0.7 (7, 4.9, 3.4). Skips you, your pets, villagers and workers. 1 s cooldown. 1,000,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.autarky_seed: Made by the Seed Matrix only. Throw it like an ender pearl onto open ground of a T6 colony: it needs a free outpost slot, 64 to 512 blocks from the Core, 64 from other outposts, a loaded footprint without block entities and with less than half fluid. A glow ring spreads, the ground levels, the blocks rise from the soil, spans connect and the crew unfolds, in about 1,100 ticks. A failed landing drops the seed with a message.
jei.autarkia.info.basic_circuit: Crafting table or fabricator. For electric machines and drones.
jei.autarkia.info.bastion_block: Indestructible while its own colony's T6 grid runs a Singularity Core and stores at least 1,000,000 FE: no break progress for survival players, blast resistance 3,600,000, Withers and the Ender Dragon cannot break it, pistons cannot move it. Otherwise it is like obsidian (hardness 50, resistance 1,200, diamond pickaxe).
jei.autarkia.info.bastion_glass: Glass variant of the Bastion block with the same protection rules.
jei.autarkia.info.battery_bank: Stores 400,000 FE, I/O 1,024 FE/t, no leak. Charges an FE item in its slot at 2,048 FE/t.
jei.autarkia.info.belt: Conveyor, 2 blocks/s, 2 entries of up to 8 items per block. All belts of a line share the head's 1,000 FE buffer and use 1 FE/t each. Inputs at the back, the sides and the top; output into the block in front. A blocked line jams after 30 s.
jei.autarkia.info.belt_splitter: Inline: Alternate sends entries front and side in turn (the other output when one is full); Filter sends matching entries to the side. 2 FE/t.
jei.autarkia.info.blast_smelter: 2 x 2 x 2 heavy machine on foundation. 64 FE/t heats it to 1,000 (+10 per tick); it works only when hot. 3 washed ore to 4 ingots, 1 iron + 2 coal to steel, 3 copper + 1 zinc to 4 brass, and any furnace recipe in 100 ticks.
jei.autarkia.info.boiler: 2 x 3 x 2. Burns fuel at fire level 0 to 4 (GUI) and makes 10 mB steam per level per tick from water (bucket slot, pipes or water sources next to its bottom). Pressure = steam / 400 bar. It bursts at 12 bar or after 10 s dry at 200 C.
jei.autarkia.info.brass_ingot: Crucible or blast smelter: 3 copper + 1 zinc.
jei.autarkia.info.bronze_axe: Strips logs, disables shields for 5 s. 9 damage.
jei.autarkia.info.bronze_pickaxe: Mines what an iron pickaxe mines. Speed 6.5, 300 uses.
jei.autarkia.info.bronze_sling: Hold use 5 to 20 ticks, then release. Throws cobblestone (3 damage) or any nugget (4 damage). 1 durability per shot, 0.5 s cooldown.
jei.autarkia.info.bronze_sword: 6 damage, 1.6 attacks per second, sweep attack.
jei.autarkia.info.builder_drone: T3 drone, FE battery 80,000. Flies; places, cuts and repairs blocks (any block), strings spans up to insulated. Charges at a recharge dock.
jei.autarkia.info.cable_car_station: 2 x 3 x 2 end of a cable car line. Wrench one station, then another 16 to 160 blocks away (height difference up to 48); both cables and the space under them must be free. 1 to 8 gondolas (4 steel plates + 2 iron chains each) carry 27 stacks at 6 blocks/s for 64 FE/t; they stop 60 to 200 ticks at each station. Strong wind slows the line above 30 degrees of swing and holds it above 45.
jei.autarkia.info.cable_layer_drone: T4 drone, FE battery 200,000. Places hv_pylons (5,000 FE each, one pylon per cargo slot, 3 slots) and strings HV spans (2,000 FE). Holds a travel ticket outside force-loaded chunks.
jei.autarkia.info.capacitor_bank: Energy storage: 50,000 FE, I/O 2,048 FE/t, small leak. Charges an FE item in its slot. Takes lightning energy without a rate limit.
jei.autarkia.info.capsule_station: Sends and receives one stack per capsule. Mode Send, Receive or Both; filter; priority 0 to 9. A launch costs 40 FE, one per 10 ticks. Capsules go to matching filtered stations first (highest priority, then nearest), else to stations with an empty filter. A capsule that cannot unload waits 30 s, then re-targets or returns home.
jei.autarkia.info.capsule_tube: Glass tube for capsules, 8 blocks/s. Connects to tubes and to station mouths on all sides. A network holds up to 512 tubes and 32 stations; over the cap it stops. Breaking a tube drops the capsules inside it.
jei.autarkia.info.catch_net: 3 x 3 net. Catches launched crates that come down within 1.5 blocks of its centre and puts the contents and the empty crate into the storage directly below its centre. No room below: the crate bounces off and lands beside the net as a crate block.
jei.autarkia.info.catwalk: See-through steel grate to walk on.
jei.autarkia.info.chute: Gravity slide: 1 to 4 items per entry slide down and leave one block lower in front. Right-click inserts; it also pulls from an inventory above. A full target makes items wait; nothing drops.
jei.autarkia.info.claim_marker: Place two to mark the corners of a nanite claim box. Glows faintly, no collision.
jei.autarkia.info.coolant_cell: Fabricator: 1 vantite steel ingot, 2 blue ice, 1 lattice shard to 2 cells. Keeps superconductors cold.
jei.autarkia.info.copper_concentrate: Froth flotation: 1 crushed ore to 2 concentrate. Smelts, blasts or electrolyzes to 1 ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.copper_wire_spool: Copper wire: click one node, then another (max 16 blocks, rated 256 FE/t). Above its rating the wire heats: orange at 40%, red at 70%, it snaps with arcs at 100% and can set fires.
jei.autarkia.info.core_seed: Use on the top of dirt or stone with a free 3 x 3 x 3 space. The Core grows for 10 s, then claims a 33 x 33 domain, gives a Porter capsule and a field manual.
jei.autarkia.info.core_upgrade_t2: Use on an active T1 Colony Core (owner or trusted): the Core upgrades for 5 s, then the colony is T2 with a bigger domain, more workers and the T2 templates.
jei.autarkia.info.core_upgrade_t3: Use on a T2 Colony Core: T3, domain half-size 32, 14 workers, Builder Drones, warehouse, failure memory.
jei.autarkia.info.core_upgrade_t4: Use on a T3 Colony Core: T4, domain half-size 48, 20 workers, up to 6 outposts (half-size 24) with HV pylon lines and cable cars, Surveyors, Cable-Layers and Sentinels.
jei.autarkia.info.core_upgrade_t6: Use on an active tier 5 Core (owner or trusted): after 100 ticks the colony is tier 6. Domain half-size 96, worker cap 32, 8 projects, 6 domain beacons of half-size 24, 6 outposts.
jei.autarkia.info.crab_frame: The frame of a Hauler Crab or Loader.
jei.autarkia.info.crate: 27-slot storage. The top shows piles of its contents. Sneak + use with a wrench picks it up with everything inside.
jei.autarkia.info.crate_launcher: Throws a crate with all 27 input stacks on a ballistic arc (45, 55, 65 or 75 degrees, the lowest clear one) into a catch net 8 to 96 blocks away. Wrench the launcher, then the net. Needs an empty crate and 1,000 FE + 40 FE per block; one shot per 60 ticks. Fires when the input is full or idle for 10 s. Three misses in 10 minutes pause it until Reset.
jei.autarkia.info.crucible: Alloys over heat: 3 copper + 1 tin = 4 bronze. Lit campfire 0.5x, lit furnace 1.0x, lava 1.5x speed.
jei.autarkia.info.cryo_node: 1 x 3 x 1 superconductor node, 4 spans at its top. 4 coolant cell slots; each cell holds 24,000 units. It uses 1 unit per tick plus 1 per attached span above half load, and it is cold while it has coolant. A span warms when one of its ends is not cold and quenches with a blast at full temperature (about 25 s).
jei.autarkia.info.deepslate_zinc_ore: Zinc ore in deepslate. Drops raw zinc.
jei.autarkia.info.depot: 54-slot outpost storage. It belongs to the outpost core within 16 blocks (else to the main site) and reports its stock to the linked stock view of every ledger terminal. Remote site requests push the items into an adjacent cable car station, crate launcher, mag rail station or capsule station.
jei.autarkia.info.disassembler_beam: Hold use: a 24-block beam for up to 5 s, 2,000 FE/t. Takes apart 2 blocks per tick up to blast resistance 50; never block entities, bastion blocks or other colonies' domains. 6 beam damage to the first mob, once per 0.5 s. Matter link like the nanite multitool. Overheat: 3 s cooldown. 20,000,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.domain_archive: One per domain: a live view of every warehouse, depot, matter buffer and tally board area of the domain, and instant delivery of up to 1,728 items per request into its 27-slot buffer or to a receiving matter conduit (16 FE per item, idle 256 FE/t). It also shows the free MU and the last matter withdrawals. A second archive does nothing.
jei.autarkia.info.domain_beacon: Place inside a T3+ domain: adds a square of half-size 16 (T5+: 24) around it. Needs 32 FE/t; without power its area is INACTIVE and the planner ignores it. Max 2 at T3, 3 at T4, 4 at T5, 6 at T6.
jei.autarkia.info.drone_frame: Frame of the Builder Drone, Surveyor, Cable-Layer and Sentinel.
jei.autarkia.info.electric_chainsaw: Axe, speed 12, 9 damage. Cutting a log fells the whole tree (up to 256 logs, 16 per tick, 150 FE per log). Sneak to cut one log.
jei.autarkia.info.electric_drill: Pickaxe and shovel, diamond level, speed 12. 400,000 FE, 200 FE per block. Empty: speed 1, no drops.
jei.autarkia.info.electrolyzer: 256 FE/t, 160 ticks: 1 pure ore to 1 ingot plus a secondary nugget at 10%.
jei.autarkia.info.exo_rig_boots: 3 armor, 2 toughness. Cancels fall damage above 3 blocks for 100 FE per block. 500,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.exo_rig_chest: 7 armor, 2 toughness. +0.25 jump strength, 100 FE per jump. 500,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.exo_rig_helmet: 3 armor, 2 toughness. Balances FE between the worn exo pieces every second, +1 oxygen. 500,000 FE. Suit key: on/off.
jei.autarkia.info.exo_rig_legs: 6 armor, 2 toughness. Step up 1.1 blocks, 2 FE per tick while walking. 500,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.fabricator: 2 x 2 x 1. 160 FE/t. Pick a target recipe with the recipe button; it pulls the ingredients from its 3 x 3 buffer and makes circuits, servos, frames and equipment.
jei.autarkia.info.field_manual: The Autarkia guide: tiers, machines, the colony and its workers.
jei.autarkia.info.forge_of_ascension: 3 x 4 x 3 chamber. Load the Aegis inputs, wear lattice carapace pieces, stand on the pad and sneak + use it with empty hands. 30 s fitting: boots, legs, chest, helmet, 12,500,000 FE each from the Forge's grid (50,000,000 FE needed at the start). You cannot move or take damage while fitted. Leaving the pad or a grid that cannot pay aborts: fitted pieces stay, the current carapace piece comes back.
jei.autarkia.info.foundation: Heavy building block. Heavy machines from T2 need it under every bottom position.
jei.autarkia.info.frontier_suit_boots: 3 armor, 3 toughness. Jet boots: hold jump in the air to climb (+0.1 per tick, up to 0.5 blocks/tick), 80 FE/t. Cancels fall damage above 3 blocks for 50 FE per block. 2,000,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.frontier_suit_chest: 8 armor, 3 toughness. Wind resistance: +0.3 knockback and +0.5 explosion knockback resistance, 2 FE/t. Keeps the exo rig jump boost. 2,000,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.frontier_suit_helmet: 3 armor, 3 toughness. Night vision, 10 FE/t. Keeps every exo rig helmet function. 2,000,000 FE. Suit key: on/off.
jei.autarkia.info.frontier_suit_legs: 6 armor, 3 toughness. Step up 1.1 blocks (2 FE/t while walking), +20% speed while sprinting (10 FE/t). 2,000,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.froth_flotation_plant: 3 x 3 x 3 heavy machine on foundation. 768 FE/t, 10 s: 1 crushed ore + 250 mB water to 2 concentrate, slag at 50% and a secondary nugget at 35%. Water from the bucket slot, from pipes, or pumped at 50 mB/t from a water source next to the bottom layer.
jei.autarkia.info.fuse_box: Inline node with exactly 2 spans of one tier. Opens at 100% load for 1 s or 150% at once, or when lightning reaches it; closes again after 10 s. After 3 trips in a minute it stays open until reset (button or wrench).
jei.autarkia.info.gold_concentrate: Froth flotation: 1 crushed ore to 2 concentrate. Smelts, blasts or electrolyzes to 1 ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.grapple_launcher: 2,000 FE per shot: the hook flies 48 blocks at 3 blocks/tick and holds on the first block it hits. Hold use: pulled at 1.2 blocks/tick for 20 FE/t; sneak to hang in place for 5 FE/t. Release to let go: no fall damage for 2 s. 0.5 s cooldown. 1,000,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.gyro_heart: 5 x 3 x 5 flywheel storage: 2,000,000,000 FE, I/O 1,048,576 FE/t x max(0.1, spin), spin = sqrt(E / max). Self-loss 1 + 0.0000001 x E per tick. From 1% charge it cannot be broken by hand or by explosions: spin it down first. The wrench cycles a face: none, in, out, both.
jei.autarkia.info.hand_crank: Generator. Hold use on it to turn: 20 FE/t (a Porter gives 10 FE/t). Buffer 1,000 FE, out 40 FE/t. Output stops 6 ticks after you let go.
jei.autarkia.info.hv_cable_spool: HV line: 8,192 FE/t, spans up to 48 blocks, loss 0.02% per block. One spool per 16 blocks. Overload heats it; wind cools it and makes it sway. A snapped HV line whips for 10 s with a large arc: 10 damage and fire.
jei.autarkia.info.hv_pylon: 1 x 7 x 1 node for HV line, 4 spans. Feeds the machines next to its base. Spans attach at the top arms.
jei.autarkia.info.hydro_turbine: 3 x 3 x 3 generator. Head = water blocks in a straight column above the top-center intake, max 32. Output 128 FE/t per block of head, max 4,096. The outlet in front of the bottom center must be air or water. Water is not used up. Buffer 50,000 FE, out 8,192 FE/t.
jei.autarkia.info.industrial_lamp: Light 15 while it has power (1 FE/t). Flickers when its network cannot keep it full. When a snap cuts its supply it goes dark 3 ticks per hop from the break.
jei.autarkia.info.insulated_cable_spool: Insulated cable: 1,024 FE/t, spans up to 24 blocks (12 to or from a wall insulator), loss 0.1% per block. One spool per 16 blocks. Overload heats it: smoke, flame, snap, fire.
jei.autarkia.info.iron_concentrate: Froth flotation: 1 crushed ore to 2 concentrate. Smelts, blasts or electrolyzes to 1 ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.jaw_crusher: 2 x 2 x 2 heavy machine on foundation. 192 FE/t, 100 ticks: 1 raw ore to 2 crushed ore; cobblestone to gravel, gravel to sand.
jei.autarkia.info.lattice_alloy_ingot: Plasma separator alloying: 1 lattice crystal + 1 vantite steel ingot, 10 s at 4,096 FE/t. For T5 machines and lattice gear.
jei.autarkia.info.lattice_blade: 12 damage, 1.6 attacks/s. 200 FE per hit: armor protects only half as much against the hit. At 0 FE: normal hits. 5,000,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.lattice_carapace_boots: 4 armor, 4 toughness, 0.15 knockback resistance. Jet boots and fall protection of the frontier suit. Self-repair: 1 durability per second for 2,000 FE. 5,000,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.lattice_carapace_chest: 9 armor, 4 toughness, 0.15 knockback resistance. Keeps the exo rig and frontier suit chest functions. Self-repair: 1 durability per second for 2,000 FE. 5,000,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.lattice_carapace_helme: 4 armor, 4 toughness, 0.15 knockback resistance. Keeps every exo rig and frontier suit helmet function. Self-repair: 1 durability per second for 2,000 FE. 5,000,000 FE. Suit key: on/off.
jei.autarkia.info.lattice_carapace_legs: 7 armor, 4 toughness, 0.15 knockback resistance. Keeps the exo rig and frontier suit leg functions. Self-repair: 1 durability per second for 2,000 FE. 5,000,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.lattice_cluster: Grows in lattice geodes deep underground (Y -58 to -24, about 1 chunk in 40): blackstone outside, calcite, then the shell. Clusters sit only on charged shells. Needs a vantite or better pickaxe: 2 lattice shards (fortune adds more); silk touch keeps the cluster.
jei.autarkia.info.lattice_crystal: 4 lattice shards. Plasma separator: 1 crystal + 1 vantite steel ingot to 1 lattice alloy ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.lattice_fuel_cell: Fabricator: 2 lattice shards, 1 vantite steel ingot, 1 blaze powder. Fuel of the plasma generator.
jei.autarkia.info.lattice_geode_shell: Inner layer of a lattice geode (Y -58 to -24). Charged shells grow new lattice clusters on free faces over time, cannot be moved by pistons and break into nothing; plain shells drop themselves.
jei.autarkia.info.lattice_rack: Holds 4 crates (filled or empty). Load rating 65,536 units: 4 crates of iron blocks are 62,240 units (95%). Bends above 100%, collapses after 60 s above 120%, at once above 150%. Drops 2 lattice shards when it collapses.
jei.autarkia.info.lattice_shard: From lattice clusters. 4 shards craft a lattice crystal; the fabricator turns shards into nanite paste and cells.
jei.autarkia.info.ledger_terminal: Search the warehouse stock and request 1 to 1,728 of an item. A Loader brings the crate: the items go to you within 6 blocks, else to the 18-slot output. Items in the 9 input slots are put away; empty crates in the crate slot become new stock positions.
jei.autarkia.info.lightning_arrester: Place on top of a pole: a lightning pulse stops there. Next to a machine: it protects that machine.
jei.autarkia.info.lightning_mast: 4 blocks tall. Bolts within 48 blocks move to it; it puts 120,000 FE into the capacitor banks of its network. Thunder can strike it on its own.
jei.autarkia.info.lineman: T3 walker, FE battery 60,000. Climbs poles at 0.1 blocks/tick; strings and cuts spans up to insulated, places fuse boxes and poles.
jei.autarkia.info.loader: T3 forklift crab, FE battery 120,000. Carries warehouse crates between racks and ledger terminals (1,500 FE per lift).
jei.autarkia.info.mag_rail: Track for mag rail sleds: place in a chain between mag rail stations; it bends and climbs like a rail, without junctions, and needs a solid block below. A line holds up to 2,048 rails, 16 stations and 32 sleds. A sled that reaches a gap falls and lands as a crate block with all its items.
jei.autarkia.info.mag_rail_station: Inline or end stop of a mag rail line. It packs its 27 input stacks into an empty crate and sends the crate as a sled when the input is full or idle 10 s: 2,000 FE per launch (16,000 FE buffer, 512 FE/t), 20 blocks/s with acceleration and braking. Destination: a named station or Next. One track: a sled waits in the station while another runs the other way or is less than 8 blocks ahead. Arrivals unload into the output; with no room the sled waits above the station.
jei.autarkia.info.magma_tap: 1 x 2 x 1 generator on a magma vent (2,048 FE/t, endless) or a lava source (1,024 FE/t; after 24,000 running ticks the lava turns into obsidian). Needs a water source next to its upper block; without one, half output and smoke. Buffer 20,000 FE, out 8,192 FE/t.
jei.autarkia.info.magma_vent: Glowing vent in cave floors (Y -60 to -16, about 1 chunk in 8) and in the Nether (Y 10 to 60). An endless lava source for the Magma Tap. Drops a magma block; silk touch keeps the vent.
jei.autarkia.info.magnetic_separator: 128 FE/t, 120 ticks: 2 washed ore to 3 pure ore, 1 slag and a secondary nugget at 50%.
jei.autarkia.info.matter_buffer: 2 x 2 x 2 store of 1,048,576 matter units (MU). Items keep their identity; each counts its MU from the matter table (Shift on any tooltip shows it; raw ores x6 at T5, x8 at T6). Dissolve turns all of one item into free MU for good. With Auto on it dissolves cobblestone, dirt, gravel, sand, netherrack, tuff and slag while the domain has less than 65,536 free MU. Refuses items with no value, filled containers and seeds. No power needed.
jei.autarkia.info.matter_compiler: 2 x 2 x 2 heavy machine on foundation, 16,384 FE/t. Writes matter units into items: pick a target (ingots, nuggets, lattice crystal, lattice alloy, aegis plate), feed anything with a matter value (raw ores count x8) or let it pull free MU from the matter buffers of its domain. Buffer 65,536 MU; one item takes max(1 s, MU / 32 ticks): an iron ingot 1 s, an aegis plate 51.2 s.
jei.autarkia.info.matter_conduit: Instant item transfer inside a colony domain. A SEND conduit moves up to 64 items per tick (8 FE each) to the RECEIVE conduits of the same colour channel, which push into the block they face. Buffer 9 slots. Without FE items wait; outside a domain the conduit does nothing.
jei.autarkia.info.multimeter: Use on a connector or machine port: shows the network generation, demand, service, losses and every span of that node.
jei.autarkia.info.nanite_hive: 2 x 2 x 2, FE buffer 200,000 (8,000 FE/t in). Lists marker pairs within 64 blocks; pick one, set the depth below the lower marker (height up to 48) and terraces, press Start. Assembles a Nanite Swarm from 4 nanite paste (200 ticks, 100 FE/t), tethers it with up to 4,000 FE/t and takes the box apart top down: ores as items, other blocks as free matter into the linked matter buffer. Containers and machines stay.
jei.autarkia.info.nanite_multitool: Pickaxe, axe, shovel, hoe, shears and sword-efficient, netherite level, speed 24, 9 damage. 10,000,000 FE, 100 FE per block. Mode key: 1x1 or 3x3 (x0.5 speed). Use: strip or path, sneak + use: till. Sneak + use on a matter buffer links it: drops with a matter value become MU in the tool (max 4,096 MU, 20 FE per item); within 32 blocks of the buffer the cache streams into it at 64 MU/s. Full cache or no value: drops fall. Empty: speed 1, no drops.
jei.autarkia.info.nanite_paste: Fabricator: 1 lattice shard, 4 redstone, 1 slime ball to 2 paste. For the Nanite Hive, the Replicator and lattice gear.
jei.autarkia.info.ore_outcrop: A small rock pile on the surface. It marks an ore deposit below its column: at least 12 ore blocks of its kind (8 for gold and vantite). Breaking it gives 1 raw ore of its kind.
jei.autarkia.info.outpost_seed: Fabricator: 1 advanced circuit, 2 servos, 1 crate, 4 vantite steel, 1 oak sapling; 20 s, 64,000 FE. A T4 colony carries it to a far ore deposit (64 to 512 blocks from the Core) and plants it: an Outpost Core grows in 10 s. You can plant it yourself on a free spot of a colony you manage.
jei.autarkia.info.pattern_card: Blank, or a recorded Pattern. Insert a recorded card in the Core's Patterns tab to add it to the library.
jei.autarkia.info.pattern_loom: Records a box of up to the tier size into a Pattern on a blank card: Autarkia machine settings are kept, foreign block entities are placed empty. Protect watches the box; Library adds the Pattern to the colony.
jei.autarkia.info.phase_node: Wireless phase link node: 1,048,576 FE/t, links up to 64 blocks with a clear line of sight, no loss, no heat, no sag. Use the wrench on one node, then on the other node or a transformer. 4 links per node; it feeds the blocks next to it. A blocked line turns the link off within 40 ticks; it comes back by itself.
jei.autarkia.info.planning_tablet: Use on a Colony Core to link. While held, the colony's proposals show as ghost blocks. Use to open the project list and the autonomy switch.
jei.autarkia.info.plasma_generator: 3 x 3 x 3 generator: 32,768 FE/t. Ignition (button) takes 1,000,000 FE from the network at 5,000 FE/t, then the output ramps up over 10 s. One lattice fuel cell lasts 2,400 ticks at full output. A full buffer pauses the burn; after 10 s of pause it is cold and needs a new ignition. Breaking it while hot makes an explosion. Buffer 1,000,000 FE, out 65,536 FE/t.
jei.autarkia.info.plasma_separator: 2 x 2 x 2 heavy machine on foundation. 4,096 FE/t, 5 s: 1 raw ore to 6 ingots and a secondary ingot at 20%. With a second input it alloys: lattice crystal + vantite steel ingot to lattice alloy.
jei.autarkia.info.plate_press: 48 FE/t, 80 ticks: 1 ingot to 1 plate (steel, brass).
jei.autarkia.info.pressure_valve: Place on top of a boiler: vents 25 mB/t of steam above 9 bar. One valve cannot hold fire level 4 with no load; two can.
jei.autarkia.info.project_board: Place inside a domain: shows the colony's proposals with their reason, site, cost and bill of materials. Approve, deny or show the ghost.
jei.autarkia.info.prop_beam: Temporary support. Workers put it under racks of a failing row before they replace them.
jei.autarkia.info.pure_copper: Magnetic separator: 2 washed to 3 pure. Smelts or electrolyzes to 1 ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.pure_gold: Magnetic separator: 2 washed to 3 pure. Smelts or electrolyzes to 1 ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.pure_iron: Magnetic separator: 2 washed to 3 pure. Smelts or electrolyzes to 1 ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.pure_tin: Magnetic separator: 2 washed to 3 pure. Smelts or electrolyzes to 1 ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.pure_zinc: Magnetic separator: 2 washed to 3 pure. Smelts or electrolyzes to 1 ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.quern: Manual grinder. Use with ore to insert, hold use with an empty hand to turn. 8 turns per raw ore: 1 crushed ore plus 1 more at 50%. Outputs go to an inventory below.
jei.autarkia.info.rail_rifle: Hold use 0.5 to 1.5 s, then release: 20,000 FE per shot, 8 to 24 rail damage. Hitscan 96 blocks through up to 5 targets, stops at blocks without harming them, knockback 1.5. 2 s cooldown. 3,000,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.raw_vantite: Jaw crusher: 2 crushed vantite. Blast smelter: 1 vantite ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.recharge_dock: 50,000 FE buffer from any cable. Charges one FE worker at up to 2,000 FE/t and heals 1 health per 5 s for 500 FE. Drones land on top.
jei.autarkia.info.replicator_foundry: T5, 3 x 3 x 3. Prints a Replicator Walker for the colony: 2 walker frames, 1 AI core, 8 nanite paste, 16 lattice alloy ingots, 4 advanced circuits, 8 servos and 1 outpost seed, plus the outpost kit as matter units from the matter buffers; 2,400 ticks at 2,000 FE/t. The walker walks to an unclaimed deposit up to 512 blocks away, digs in and becomes an outpost. At most 2 walkers at a time, one print per colony day.
jei.autarkia.info.restoration_projector: T6, 1 x 2 x 1. Snapshots a box of up to 64 x 32 x 64 inside your colony domain (default: centered, from 8 below to 23 above the projector) and puts lost blocks back: every 100 ticks it finds the cells that are now air, fluid, fire or replaceable, and restores them edge first, 8 per tick (32 per server), 512 FE each. Debris items within 16 blocks fly back first; else the matter buffers pay. Containers come back empty. Blocks you or a trusted player break or place in the box update the snapshot. The first power takes the snapshot; the Snapshot button takes it again.
jei.autarkia.info.rope_coil: Rope drive cable: click one node, then another (max 12 blocks, rated 40 FE/t, 1 coil per 8 blocks). Above 40 FE/t the rope slips, wears and snaps.
jei.autarkia.info.rope_pulley: Rope drive connector node. Takes up to 4 rope spans of max 12 blocks. Machines and generators next to it join its network.
jei.autarkia.info.seed_matrix: T6, 3 x 3 x 3. Packs 1 to 8 recorded pattern cards into an Autarky Seed: card 1 must be an OUTPOST Pattern; set x, z and rotation per card, no footprints may overlap, and the whole footprint must lie in the outpost square (65 x 65 at T6) around the outpost core. Pack takes 1 AI core, 16 nanite paste and the parts of 2 Porters and 2 Builder Drones from colony storage, the Pattern bills as matter units from the matter buffers (20 parts), and 1,000,000 FE at 834 FE/t over 1,200 ticks. The cards stay in the matrix.
jei.autarkia.info.sentinel: T4 drone, FE battery 150,000. Patrols the Core, beacons and outposts and shoots hostiles in the domain (+8 blocks) with arcs: 8 damage every 30 ticks for 1,500 FE, range 16 (+4 per range upgrade), creepers first. Escorts outpost carriers. Never targets players, villagers, tamed animals or workers.
jei.autarkia.info.servo: Fabricator. For workers and T4 machines.
jei.autarkia.info.shock_baton: 6 damage. With 1,000 FE a hit adds 4 shock damage and Slowness II for 2 s. 200,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.singularity_core: 5 x 5 x 5 generator: 131,072 FE/t into a 1,000,000,000 FE buffer, out 1,048,576 FE/t through its machine port or adjacent connectors. Ignite takes 100,000,000 FE from its network at up to 1,048,576 FE/t; then it runs while loaded. Stop (button or sneaking wrench) keeps the buffer. In a T6 domain it drinks every explosion: 50,000 FE x radius squared, no domain block breaks and every lamp flashes. It pays the Aegis tether.
jei.autarkia.info.singularity_lance: Hold use 3 s to charge, then a 128-block beam for 1 s: 80 beam damage to everything in its path (1.5) and at its end (4.0), never you or your allies. 1,000,000 FE per shot, 10 s cooldown. Mode key: terrain-safe or terrain-destroy (a crater of radius 3, needs mobGriefing; inside any domain the beam never changes blocks). Unbreakable, 50,000,000 FE.
jei.autarkia.info.slag: Byproduct of the blast smelter. 4 slag make 2 foundation.
jei.autarkia.info.sluice: 1 x 1 x 3. Washes crushed ore: 1 crushed to 1 washed plus a secondary nugget at 10%, 100 ticks. The block behind or above the head needs water: flowing water 100%, a source only 50%. Outputs go into an inventory or belt in front of the tail, else drop.
jei.autarkia.info.sorting_chute: Inline, no power: entries that match the filter leave through the side, the rest go on. A full side blocks it.
jei.autarkia.info.stamp_mill: Powered grinder (2 blocks tall). 16 FE/t, 8 s per raw ore: 1 crushed ore plus 1 more at 50%.
jei.autarkia.info.steam_engine: 1 x 2 x 2. Its back face must touch a boiler. Uses up to 20 mB steam per tick: 6 FE per mB, max 120 FE/t. A boiler feeds at most 2 engines.
jei.autarkia.info.steam_repeater: Sneak + hold use pumps pressure (40 ticks to 100). Hold use fires a steel nugget every 5 ticks for 10 pressure: 5 damage. Pressure leaks 1 per second when not in use.
jei.autarkia.info.steam_turbine: 3 x 3 x 2. Takes up to 100 mB of steam per tick from 1 to 4 boilers touching its back or sides. The rotor spins up in 30 s and down in 60 s; out = rotor x steam x 10 FE/t, max 1,000.
jei.autarkia.info.steel_axe: Strips logs, disables shields for 5 s. 9 damage.
jei.autarkia.info.steel_pickaxe: Mines what a diamond pickaxe mines. Speed 7.5, 1,200 uses.
jei.autarkia.info.steel_pylon: 1 x 5 x 1 node for insulated cable, 6 spans. Feeds the machines next to it.
jei.autarkia.info.steel_rack: Holds 3 crates (filled or empty). Load rating 8,192 units. Bends above 100%, collapses after 60 s above 120%, at once above 150%. Drops 2 steel nuggets when it collapses.
jei.autarkia.info.steel_sledgehammer: Mode key: 1x1 or 3x3. 3x3 breaks the plane at right angles to the hit face at 35% speed, 1 durability per block. 10.5 damage, disables shields.
jei.autarkia.info.steel_sword: 6.5 damage, 1.6 attacks per second, sweep attack.
jei.autarkia.info.stone_flywheel: Energy storage with inertia: 40,000 FE, in/out 40 x spin. Needs a solid block under its middle. Break it while it holds 2,000 FE or more and the wheel rolls away and hits what is in its path.
jei.autarkia.info.superconducting_coil: 2 x 2 x 2 storage: 400,000,000 FE, I/O 65,536 FE/t (half from 50% temperature). 4 coolant cell slots, 2 units per tick. Dry it warms 0.1% per tick and quenches after 1,000 ticks: a blast of power 2 to 6, the energy is lost and it stays quenched until cold again. The wrench cycles a face: none, in, out, both.
jei.autarkia.info.superconductor_spool: Superconductor: 65,536 FE/t, spans up to 32 blocks between cryo nodes or machine ports, no loss. One spool per 8 blocks. Both ends must stay cold: frost below 30%, steam to 70%, hiss above, then a quench blast that drops nothing.
jei.autarkia.info.survey_lens: Hold it: outlines of the ore deposits within 64 blocks, through the ground, in the color of the ore.
jei.autarkia.info.surveyor: T4 drone, FE battery 60,000. Flies a square spiral over a SURVEY area (points 32 blocks apart) and scans 32 blocks around each point for 2,000 FE (+16 per range upgrade); every ore outcrop goes to the colony deposit list. Holds a travel ticket outside force-loaded chunks.
jei.autarkia.info.tally_board: Counts the items of all crates within 5 blocks every 2 seconds and shows the 6 largest counts on its face. The Colony Core reads it.
jei.autarkia.info.tin_concentrate: Froth flotation: 1 crushed ore to 2 concentrate. Smelts, blasts or electrolyzes to 1 ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.transformer: Joins two cable tiers: side A is the tier of the first span, side B the next. Moves up to the lower tier's rating per tick with 2% loss. Wrench: Auto (from the network with more spare power), A to B, B to A.
jei.autarkia.info.treadwheel: Generator. Use a lead on it while leading a horse, donkey, mule or llama (20 FE/t), a villager (16) or a cow, pig, sheep or goat (12). Sneak + use with an empty hand takes the walker back. A Porter gives 24 FE/t.
jei.autarkia.info.vantite_blade: 8.5 damage, 1.6 attacks/s, 3,000 durability. Use: dash 6 blocks forward for 12 durability; the first hit on a hostile mob right after the dash deals +4 damage. 4 s cooldown.
jei.autarkia.info.vantite_concentrate: Froth flotation: 1 crushed ore to 2 concentrate. Blast smelter or electrolyzer to 1 vantite ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.vantite_excavator: Pickaxe and shovel, netherite level, speed 16. 2,000,000 FE, 250 FE per block. Mode key: 1x1, 3x3 (x0.5 speed) or vein: breaks up to 64 connected blocks of the same ore (stone and deepslate variants together), 400 FE each. Empty: speed 1, no drops.
jei.autarkia.info.vantite_ingot: Blast smelter, electrolyzer or flotation chain only. With steel in the blast smelter: vantite steel.
jei.autarkia.info.vantite_ore: Deep ore from Y -64 to 0, rarely exposed to caves. Needs a steel or diamond pickaxe; drops raw vantite. Vantite does not smelt in a furnace: use the blast smelter, electrolyzer or the flotation chain.
jei.autarkia.info.vantite_steel_ingot: Blast smelter: 1 vantite ingot + 1 steel ingot, 15 s. For T4 machines and vantite equipment.
jei.autarkia.info.walker_frame: The frame of a Porter or Lineman.
jei.autarkia.info.wall_insulator: Small node on a wall face for insulated cable, 2 spans of at most 12 blocks.
jei.autarkia.info.warehouse_controller: Indexes the racks within 16 blocks (cube; config 8 to 32), up to 256. Queues up to 16 ledger requests and hands each trip to a Loader. 64 FE/t while requests are open.
jei.autarkia.info.waterwheel: Generator, 3 wide and 3 tall. Flowing water under the bottom row (24 FE/t per block) or falling water on the top (40 FE/t per block) turns it; max 128 FE/t. Sources do not count.
jei.autarkia.info.wind_tower: Generator, 8 blocks tall. Base 512 FE/t at rotor height 64, +20 per block, max 3,072; wind x0.5 to x1.5, rain x1.15, thunder x1.3. Every solid block in the 9 x 9 area in front of the rotor costs 3%; 25 or more stop it. Buffer 40,000 FE, out 8,192 FE/t.
jei.autarkia.info.winding_post: Charger for spring workers: 40 T/t for 80 FE/t from a cable, or 10 T/t while a player holds use on it.
jei.autarkia.info.windmill: Generator, 4 blocks tall. Output 4 to 40 FE/t: higher rotors, stronger wind and rain or thunder give more. Every solid block in the 5 x 5 area in front of the rotor costs 10%; 5 or more stop it.
jei.autarkia.info.wire_cutter: Click one node, then the other: the span is removed and its cable comes back.
jei.autarkia.info.wire_drawer: 40 FE/t, 100 ticks: 4 copper + iron core to 2 copper coils; 2 copper with no core to 1 copper wire spool.
jei.autarkia.info.wood_rack: Holds 2 crates (filled or empty). Load rating 2,048 units: light items 0.25, most items 0.5, ingots and ores 1, machines 8, storage blocks 9, each crate 8. Above 100% it bends, above 120% it collapses after 60 s, above 150% (with a falling crate's impact) at once.
jei.autarkia.info.wooden_pole: Copper wire connector, 3 blocks tall. Takes up to 4 copper spans of max 16 blocks at its top. Machines next to its base join its network.
jei.autarkia.info.worker_assembler: 2 x 2 x 2. Put a frame and the parts in, give it FE: a Porter needs a walker frame, 2 mainsprings, 4 bronze gears and 4 bronze ingots, 600 ticks at 20 FE/t.
jei.autarkia.info.worker_capsule: Sneak + use on your idle worker to store it with its spring, cargo and upgrades. Use on the ground inside your domain to release it.
jei.autarkia.info.worker_upgrade_armor: Right-click a worker: +6 armor, +25% max health.
jei.autarkia.info.worker_upgrade_cargo: Right-click a worker: +1 carry slot (Loader: +9 pallet slots, 2 crates per trip), +5% move drain.
jei.autarkia.info.worker_upgrade_range: Right-click a worker: +2 reach, +50% charger search radius.
jei.autarkia.info.worker_upgrade_speed: Right-click a worker: +20% speed, +10% move drain. 2 slots per worker.
jei.autarkia.info.wrench: Use: turns Autarkia blocks. Sneak + use: picks up a crate with its contents, or any other Autarkia block.
jei.autarkia.info.zinc_concentrate: Froth flotation: 1 crushed ore to 2 concentrate. Smelts, blasts or electrolyzes to 1 ingot.
jei.autarkia.info.zinc_ore: Zinc ore, Y 0 to 64. Drops raw zinc.
